subject: fix: guard HNSW prefetches against empty neighbor lists (#1320)
reason: The change is internal memory-safety hardening in the bundled HNSW library and has no command-reachable behavior difference. Hunk 1 (searchBaseLayer) only moves two non-faulting __builtin_prefetch(visited_array+id) hints inside an if(size>0) block; the sole dereferencing prefetch there was already guarded, so nothing observable changes. Hunk 2 (repairConnectionsForUpdate) adds `if (size == 0) break;` before an unguarded dereferencing prefetch, but the control flow is identical either way (the following for-loop was already size-bounded and `changed` stayed false), so it only skips the prefetch
